bibl.title: Die Reform der ägyptischen Lokalverwaltung unter Philippus Arabs.
bibl.seg: Bernhard Palme, Die Reform der ägyptischen Lokalverwaltung unter Philippus Arabs.
Ulrike Babusiaux & Anna Kolb (edd.), Das Recht der "Soldatenkaiser". Rechtliche Stabilität in Zeiten politischen Umbruchs? (Berlin - Munich - Boston, 2015) pp. 192-208.
bibl.note: During the reign of Emperor Philip the Arab, the province of Egypt saw major fiscal and administrative reforms that aimed at a fundamental restructuring of the system of tax assessment: a series of traditional offices at the level of the nomes and villages, as well as certain positions in the procuratorial administration, disappeared and were replaced by new offices with significantly altered spheres of activity.
